records.text: At that very time Thanthanai, governor beyond the river, Satharbouzana and their fellow slaves came against them and said, “Who issued you a decision to build this house and put this provision in order?”
Then they said these things to them: “What are the names of the men building this city?”
But God’s eyes were upon the captivity of Judah, and they did not stop them until a report had been carried to Darius; then word was sent to the tax collector about this.

The elders of the Jews and the Levites were building through the prophecy of Haggai the prophet and Zacharias son of Addo. They rebuilt and put it in order by the decree of the God of Israel and by the decree of Cyrus, Darius and Arthasastha, kings of the Persians.
They completed this house by the third day of the month of Adar, in the sixth year of the reign of Darius the king.

In the first year of Cyrus king of the Persians, so that the Lord’s word through Jeremiah’s mouth might be fulfilled, the Lord stirred the spirit of Cyrus king of the Persians. He ordered a proclamation throughout his kingdom, also in writing, saying:
“Thus says Cyrus king of the Persians: The Lord, God of heaven, has given me all the kingdoms of the earth, and He has charged me to build Him a house in Jerusalem in Judea.
Who among you belongs to any of His people? His God will be with him, and he will go up to Jerusalem in Judea. Let him build the house of the God of Israel—He is the God in Jerusalem.

As for everyone left behind, from whatever place he resides in, the men of his place will take him up with silver, gold, belongings and livestock, together with the freewill offering for the house of God in Jerusalem.”
All those around them strengthened their hands with silver vessels, gold, belongings, livestock and gifts of hospitality, apart from the freewill offerings.
And I will shatter the arrogance of your pride, and make your heaven iron, and your land as bronze;
and your strength shall be in vain. Your land shall not yield its seed, and the tree of your field shall not yield its fruit.

Before those days people’s wages will bring no benefit, and animals’ hire will not exist; those going out or coming in will have no peace because of affliction. I will send everyone out against his neighbor.
Everyone whose heart prompted him and whose soul was willing brought an offering to the Lord for all the work of the Tent of Testimony, for all its service, and for all the holy robes.
The men brought from the women, everyone whose heart approved: seals, earrings, rings, chains, bracelets, and every gold object—all who brought gold offerings to the Lord.
No man shall withstand you all the days of your life. As I was with Moses, so I will be with you; I will not forsake you or disregard you.
Be strong and courageous, for you shall apportion to this people the land which I swore to your fathers to give them.

Be strong and courageous, then, to keep and do what Moses My servant commanded you. Do not turn aside from these commands to the right or to the left, so that you may have understanding in all that you do.

This book of the law shall not depart from your mouth. Meditate on it day and night, so that you may understand how to do all that is written. Then you shall prosper and make your ways prosper, and then you shall understand.

In the second year after their arrival at the house of God in Jerusalem, in the second month, Zorobabel son of Salathiel, Iesous son of Iosedek, the rest of their brothers the priests and Levites, and all who had come from captivity to Jerusalem began. They set the Levites from twenty years old and upward over those doing the work in the Lord’s house.
Iesous and his sons and his brothers, Kadmiel and his sons, sons of Judah, stood over those doing the work in the house of God; also the sons of Enadad, their sons and their brothers the Levites.

They laid the foundation for building the Lord’s house, and the priests stood in their vestments with trumpets, and the Levites, sons of Asaph, with cymbals, to praise the Lord according to the directions of David king of Israel.

They answered in praise and thanksgiving to the Lord: “For it is good, for His mercy toward Israel endures for ever.” All the people sounded a great cry of praise to the Lord at the founding of the Lord’s house.
Who are you, great mountain, before Zerubbabel, to set things straight? I will bring out the stone of inheritance—an equality of grace, its grace.”
The word of the Lord came to me, saying:
“Zerubbabel’s hands laid this house’s foundation, and his hands will complete it. You will recognize that the Lord Almighty has sent me to you.
For who treated the small days with contempt? They will rejoice and see the tin stone in Zerubbabel’s hand. These seven are the Lord’s eyes, looking over all the earth.”
See that you do not refuse the One who speaks. For if those who refused the One instructing them on earth did not escape, much less shall we, if we turn away from the One from the heavens.
Therefore, since we are receiving an unshakable kingdom, let us be grateful, and through this gratitude serve God acceptably with reverence and awe,
for indeed our God is a consuming fire.
And the earthenware vessel in which it is boiled shall be broken; but if it is boiled in a bronze vessel, he shall scour it and rinse it with water.
Every male among the priests shall eat them; they are most holy unto the Lord.
And none of the offerings for sin whose blood is brought into the Tent of Testimony to make atonement in the holy place shall be eaten; they shall be burned with fire.

And if a man is defiled, and is not purified, that soul shall be destroyed from the midst of the congregation, because he has defiled the holy things of the Lord; because water of sprinkling was not sprinkled upon him, he is unclean.
And this shall be an everlasting ordinance for you. The one who sprinkles the water of sprinkling shall wash his clothes, and whosoever touches the water of sprinkling shall be unclean until evening.
For I knew your many impieties, and your sins are strong: trampling the righteous, taking payments and turning aside the poor at the gates.
and hand you into the hands of those seeking your life, those before whom you are afraid, into the hands of the Chaldeans.
And I will cast you and your mother who bore you into a land where you were not born, and there you both will die.
But to the land for which they pray in their souls, they will certainly not return.
Jeconiah was dishonored like a vessel for which there is no use, because he was cast out and thrown into a land he did not know.
Land, land, hear the Lord’s word:
Record this man as an outcast, because no man from his offspring will grow great sitting on David’s throne and ruling again in Judah.
and My jealousy. In the fire of My anger I have spoken: Surely on that day there will be a great shaking upon Israel’s land,

and the sea’s fish, the sky’s birds, the plain’s beasts, every creeping thing upon the earth and every human upon the earth’s face will shake before the Lord. The mountains will split, the ravines will fall, and every wall will fall to the ground.
I will judge him with death, blood, flooding rain and hailstones. I will rain fire and sulfur upon him, all those with him and the many nations with him.
I will be magnified, sanctified, glorified and made known before many nations, and they will know that I am the Lord.’”
“These things I have spoken to you while remaining with you.
But the Advocate, the Holy Spirit, whom the Father will send in My name, He will teach you all things and remind you of all that I said to you.
King David said to the whole assembly, “Solomon my son, the one whom the Lord has chosen, is young and tender, and the work is great, for the building is for the Lord God, not for a human being.
With all my strength I have prepared for my God’s house gold, silver, bronze, iron, timber, soom stones and filling stones, costly and variegated stones, every precious stone, and much Parian marble.

Moreover, because I delight in my God’s house, I have gold and silver that I have acquired for myself. Behold, I give it to my God’s house in addition, apart from what I have prepared for the house of holy things:
three thousand talents of gold from Souphir and seven thousand talents of tested silver to coat the sanctuary’s walls with them,
by the craftsmen’s hand. Who is eager to fill his hands today for the Lord?”
The ancestral rulers, the rulers of Israel’s sons, the commanders of thousands and hundreds, the overseers of the works, and the king’s stewards offered eagerly.

They gave for the works of the Lord’s house five thousand talents of gold and ten thousand gold coins, ten thousand talents of silver, eighteen thousand talents of bronze, and a hundred thousand talents of iron.
Those who had a stone gave it to the storerooms of the Lord’s house through Jiiel the Gersoni.
The people rejoiced because of their eagerness, for they offered eagerly to the Lord with a full heart. King David rejoiced greatly.

Then King Arthasastha’s tax collector read before Raoum, Samsai the scribe and their fellow slaves. They hurried to Jerusalem and into Judah and stopped them with horses and force.
And the Lord spoke unto Moses, saying,
The word of the Lord Almighty came, saying:
“Thus says the Lord Almighty: I have been jealous for Jerusalem and Zion with great jealousy; with great wrath I have been jealous for her.
Thus says the Lord: I will return to Zion and dwell within Jerusalem. Jerusalem will be called the True City, and the mountain of the Lord Almighty a Holy Mountain.
Thus says the Lord Almighty: Old men and old women will again sit in Jerusalem’s squares, each holding a staff in hand because of many days.
The city’s squares will be filled with boys and girls playing in her squares.
Thus says the Lord Almighty: If it is impossible before this people’s remnant in those days, surely it will not also be impossible before Me? says the Lord Almighty.
Thus says the Lord Almighty: Look, I am rescuing My people from the eastern land and from the western land,
and I will bring them in and dwell within Jerusalem. They will be My people, and I will be their God in truth and righteousness.
And the Lord spoke unto Aaron, saying:

You shall drink no wine or strong drink, you and your sons with you, when you enter the Tent of Testimony, or when you approach the altar, so that you do not die: an everlasting statute throughout your generations,
Judas—not the Iscariot—says to Him, “Lord, what then has happened that Thou art going to reveal Thyself to us and not to the world?”
Jesus answered and said to him, “If anyone loves Me, he will keep My word, and My Father will love him, and We will come to him and make Our dwelling with him.
The one who does not love Me does not keep My words. And the word that you hear is not Mine, but the Father’s who sent Me.
